headline: ATL @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.54 at BOS 3.25, with a projected total of 7.79. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: ATL moved +0.27 runs while BOS moved +0.07, changing the projected margin by +0.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.34, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bryce Elder has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willson Contreras, Ceddanne Rafaela, Jarren Duran, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin, Sandy León because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
